title: Task-Utility IQA: Rethinking Image Quality Assessment in Embodied Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35905v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image quality assessment (IQA) underpins embodied imaging pipelines by judging whether visual quality satisfies downstream tasks, yet most existing methods learn task-agnostic scores aligned with generic human ratings on static benchmarks. This objective mismatches embodied and interactive settings, where image adequacy depends on task goals, context, and action requirements that shape an agent's decisions. We argue that IQA should shift from score regression to goal-conditioned judgment defined by embodied task utility. To this end, we propose an MLLM-based embodied IQA agent framework that reasons about task requirements, grounds quality evidence, and produces decision-facing assessments. translated_title: 任务效用图像质量评估：重新思考具身任务中的图像质量评估
translated_abstract: 图像质量评估（IQA）是具身成像流程的基础，用于判断视觉质量是否满足下游任务需求，然而现有的大多数方法学习的是与静态基准上通用人类评分对齐的任务无关分数。这一目标与具身交互式场景不匹配，因为在这些场景中，图像的充分性取决于塑造智能体决策的任务目标、上下文和动作要求。我们认为，IQA应该从分数回归转向由具身任务效用定义的目标条件判断。为此，我们提出了一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的具身IQA智能体框架，该框架能够推理任务需求、定位质量证据，并产生面向决策的评估。一项紧凑的VisDrone证据研究表明，传统的感知指标和通用的基于MLLM的IQA分数只是下游VLM任务成功的微弱代理指标，而任务条件化的效用分数能更好地预测视觉输入是否支持任务。
tldr: 提出了一种基于多模态大语言模型的具身任务效用导向图像质量评估框架，将IQA从任务无关的分数回归范式转变为由具身任务效用定义的目标条件判断，且任务条件化效用分数比传统感知指标更能预测下游任务的成功。
en_tdlr: Proposes an MLLM-based embodied IQA agent framework that shifts image quality assessment from task-agnostic score regression to goal-conditioned judgment defined by embodied task utility, with the task-conditioned utility score better predicting downstream task success than conventional perceptual metrics.
